question: Due to World War I and II the Olympic Games were NOT held in which years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1916, 1940, 1944**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Olympic Games** were not held in **1916**, **1940**, and **1944** due to World War I and II.
 
• The 1916 Games were scheduled to be held in Berlin, but were canceled due to World War I.
 
• Both the 1940 and 1944 Games were canceled because of World War II; the 1940 Games had been planned for Tokyo and then Helsinki, and the 1944 Games were to be held in London.
 
• These cancellations marked the first times in the modern Olympic era that the Games were not held at four-year intervals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Event
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Olympic Games**
 An international multi-sport event divided into summer and winter games, occurring every four years with athletes from all over the world.
 
 

 **International Olympic Committee (IOC)**
 The governing body responsible for the Olympic Movement, ensuring the regular celebration of the Olympic Games.
 
 

 **Olympic Charter**
 A set of rules and guidelines for organizing the Olympic Games and governing the Olympic movement.
 
 

 **Olympism**
 A philosophy of life that places sport at the service of humanity, promoting peace, friendship, and fair play.
 
 

 **Paralympic Games**
 A multi-sport event for athletes with disabilities, held shortly after the Olympic Games in the same host city.
